description: Merge two Zendesk organizations by combining all users, tickets, and data from the losing organization into the winning organization. This action is irreversible — once merged, the losing organization and all its data cannot be recovered. Use when you need to consolidate duplicate organizations or combine organization data into a single organization.

inputSchema.description: Request model for merging two Zendesk organizations.

organization_id.description: The ID of the organization to merge from (the losing organization that will be merged into another)
organization_id.human_parameter_description: The numeric ID of the organization to merge from. This organization will be merged into the winner organization and then deleted.
organization_id.title: Organization Id

winner_id.description: The ID of the winning organization that will receive all users and tickets from the losing organization
winner_id.human_parameter_description: The numeric ID of the organization to merge into. All users and tickets from the losing organization will be transferred here.
winner_id.title: Winner Id
